recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-inspired graphic layout featuring a central high-contrast group portrait framed within a 3D-effect box, set against a solid ochre-yellow background with bold, stylized display typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The heavy black 3D drop shadow on the top text mirrors the depth of the central frame.
High-contrast, duotone-style portraiture creates a gritty, screen-printed texture.
The warm ochre background provides a unified field for the stark black graphic elements.
Geometric framing creates a window effect, separating the subjects from the flat background.
coreInvariants: Minimalist color palette (Yellow, Black, White, Burnt Orange)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five figures is centered within a square frame that occupies the middle-lower two-thirds of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text at the top acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the heavy top text, moves down into the framed portrait, and finishes at the thin metadata text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right margins emphasizes the vertical central column.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre yellow background providing a warm, vintage tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for shadows, outlines, and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange and white highlights within the photographic portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black shadows and the bright yellow field.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Deep, solid black 3D drop shadows projecting downwards and to the left
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'E' and 'L' feature elongated horizontal bars that may overlap adjacent characters.
The 'S' is constructed from two interlocking circular arcs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, shadowed display type paired with ultra-light, airy metadata type.
graphicDevices: 3D isometric frame with thick black interior walls

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, rounded 70s soul aesthetic.
Good match for the thin, clean metadata text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid ochre-yellow background. In the center, place a square frame with a thick black 3D interior shadow. Inside the frame, place a high-contrast, duotone (black and burnt orange) group portrait of five men with a vintage screen-printed texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, custom-lettered display text at the top with a deep black isometric drop shadow. Add a single line of ultra-light, spaced-out sans-serif text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat ochre yellow?
Does the top text have a deep, solid black 3D shadow?
Is the central image high-contrast and duotone?
Is there a clear 3D effect on the central frame?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait
mustRedesign: Original brand logos or catalog numbers

avoid: Drop shadows with blur or transparency

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is blurry or has soft shadows.
Confirm the yellow is muted/ochre, not neon.
Check that the 3D shadow on the text and frame share the same angle.
Verify the portrait looks like a high-contrast lithograph.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid vintage color field + 3D isometric frame + high-contrast duotone portrait + heavy shadowed display type.
